> `internal/cli/missiongate.go:902-909`
> **🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟠 Major** | **🏗️ Heavy lift**
> 
> **Require the named eval before shipping a listed eval fix.**
> 
> `gateEvals` records failures as `eval:<case>` or `eval:<group>`, but `judgeGateFix` accepts every non-`verify:` entry without checking it at the PR head. `ship` checks only branch-protection contexts, so it never requires that named eval to pass. A listed eval fix can therefore merge without a passing evaluation.
> 
> Make `ship` enforce the named eval at the PR head, or fail closed when it cannot enforce that evaluation.
>
